hint_ladder: Ask the speaker to say the same words once more.
Say the two words with rising intonation as the request, then name what you missed.
Start with the words: ___? I didn't quite catch the name.
teaching_content.reveal_form: Come again? I didn't quite catch the name.
canonical_forms: Come again? I didn't quite catch the name.
alternative_realizations: Come again — did you say four thirty or four fifteen?
